note: The voters, the other models defined and the adjudicator, pinned. The adjudicator is `opus`, Claude Opus 5.5 run as Claude Code subagents through files (`transport: handoff`); `claude`, Sonnet 5.5 through OpenRouter, stays defined, its pilot runs being on record, and `judge --adjudicator claude` picks it for one merge. After the pilot gemma replaced mistral as the third voter (mistral stays defined, its runs being on record). `voters` and `adjudicator` name entries of `models`, so swapping a voter is one line there. `provider` is the tag the OpenRouter endpoint listing gives the endpoint (models/<id>/endpoints), and the runner checks the listing at run time: the endpoint must exist, have the quantisation pinned here, and support every parameter sent. `temperature` and `reasoning` are sent only when not null, since the request requires every parameter it sends: Mistral's endpoint lists no `reasoning`, and the Anthropic route lists no `temperature`. `reasoning` is passed through as OpenRouter's object; the adjudicator thinks at low effort, and `max_tokens` (16000) includes the thinking. `provider_fallback` lists other pinned endpoints of the same model, in order, at the same quantisation or a more precise one than `provider`'s listing gives. When an endpoint fails in a way that is its own (HTTP 429 or 5xx through every wait, replies cut off on both halves of a split, a provider refusal) the runner abandons that run and starts a new one at the next endpoint, which asks every batch afresh; a run never changes endpoint. A network error here (connection refused, DNS, a timeout with no answer) is no endpoint's fault: the run stops and a rerun continues it. `--endpoint TAG` starts a run at a listed endpoint by hand. `settings.failure_budget` (40) is the most calls that may fail in one step, across every wait, halving and switch; `settings.abstain_limit` (0.25) is the share of a voter run's sentences that may abstain before the run ends failed. deepseek's fallback is `streamlake/fp8` alone: DeepInfra's DeepSeek runs every reply to `max_tokens`. Pins from the listings of 2026-10-07.

opus.transport_note: not called by the runner: it writes a request file per call and Claude Code subagents of the coordinator's session answer it (README.md, `handoff`). No price, temperature, reasoning or max_tokens is set: the harness decides them, and provenance (handoff/<run>/agent.json, in runs.tsv's settings) says so.

claude.temperature_note: not sent: with thinking on the API requires its default of 1, and the Anthropic route lists no temperature
